data.description:
## Context / Problem
`attach_commits` is documented as the repair path that lets the close gate tie a ticket to a landed change when no usable trailer can be discovered. During closure of `goldfilled-portly-dungbeetle`, attaching the valid merged SHA `ea394c34d13745cc0a14cea968b32f435ef15711` succeeded and the ticket state showed it under `commits`, but the deterministic close precheck still failed with “no commit references it.”

The implementation explains the contradiction: `_check_work_landed` rejects when `_referencing_commits(...)` is empty before `_attached_commit_shas(...)` is considered. Attached SHAs are used only by the later file-impact-vs-diff check.

## Approach
Make the work-landed presence decision use the union of trailer-discovered commits and validated ticket-attached commits, while retaining the existing path-impact validation and unreadable-commit policy. Add regression coverage through the close-precheck seam.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A file-impact ticket with a valid attached implementation commit passes the deterministic “work landed” presence check when no trailer-discovered commit is reachable from HEAD.
- [ ] Attached and trailer-discovered commits are both checked against the declared file impact.
- [ ] An absent attachment and absent trailer-discovered commit still fails closed with the existing actionable error.
- [ ] An unreadable attached SHA retains the documented cross-clone behavior.
- [ ] Tests cover the repaired close-precheck behavior without weakening normal trailer scanning.

## Evidence
Observed on ticket `36f4-ae53-2199-42c1`. Relevant seams: `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py::_check_work_landed`, `_attached_commit_shas`, and `tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py`.
data.title: Close gate ignores attached commits for landing proof
